title: The lockstep guard in reminder-v2-concurrency.test.ts has no test showing it fire
evidence: app/lib/reminder-v2-concurrency.test.ts lockstep() throws when the waiting queries differ from the live callers. Done: a caller that awaits a timer before its query makes lockstep reject /round 0: waiting a, running a,b/ (the fake-table describe); with the throw disabled the test fails. Test harness only; no production code involved
